chunks: God said: 'I shall send it down to you; but if any of you disbelieve after this, I shall inflict such punishment on him as I never shall inflict on any other creature.'
ai.seo_question: What is the unique punishment for those who disbelieve after receiving the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *Tanzil* (descent) of revelation, with some scholars associating it specifically with the *Al-Wasīlah* or the unique status of the Ahl al-Bayt as the bearers of divine knowledge. The 'unique punishment' (*'Adhaban la'a'adhdhibuhu ahadan*) highlights the heightened accountability of those who reject the truth after its clear manifestation, a theme central to the Shia understanding of *Hujjiyyah* (proof) and the necessity of accepting the Imams' guidance.
